description: Eau - Bassin d'orage - Grand Poitiers Données métiers is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sig.grandpoitiers.fr. The storm basin temporarily retains surplus rainwater. The basins also provide action for settling suspended solids, pollutant retention and salt dilution. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Water — Storm basin — Grand Poitiers Business data" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include réservoir, bassin, données ouvertes, orage, eau de pluie. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2015-02-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
